# Lab 3.8: Datastream: Cloud SQL → BigQuery

## What We Are Going to Do
Replicate a Cloud SQL for MySQL database into BigQuery in near real time with Datastream. This lab creates paid resources, so delete them at the end.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a small Cloud SQL instance with binary logging.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable sqladmin.googleapis.com datastream.googleapis.com
gcloud sql instances create lab-mysql --database-version=MYSQL_8_0 --tier=db-f1-micro \
  --region=us-central1 --enable-bin-log --backup-start-time=03:00 --root-password='ChangeMe#123'
gcloud sql databases create shop --instance=lab-mysql
gcloud sql users create datastream --instance=lab-mysql --password='Stream#123'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[CLI] Create a table with data.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql connect lab-mysql --user=root &lt;&lt;'EOF'
USE shop;
CREATE TABLE customers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50), city VARCHAR(50));
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Asha','Surat'),(2,'Ravi','Pune');
GRANT REPLICATION SLAVE, SELECT, REPLICATION CLIENT ON *.* TO 'datastream'@'%';
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Create the stream.** Go to **Datastream → Create stream**:
   - **Source**: MySQL. Create a connection profile with the instance's public IP, user `datastream`, and **IP allowlisting**. Add the Datastream IPs shown on the page to the instance's **Authorized networks**.
   - **Objects**: `shop.customers`
   - **Destination**: BigQuery, **Dataset for each schema**, location **US**, **Staleness limit**: 0 seconds.

   Click **Run validation**, then **Create and start**.

4. **[SQL] Watch the data arrive, then change the source.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM shop.customers;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud sql connect lab-mysql --user=root &lt;&lt;'EOF'
UPDATE shop.customers SET city='Mumbai' WHERE id=1;
INSERT INTO shop.customers VALUES (3,'Meera','Delhi');
EOF</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run the BigQuery query again after a minute. The update and insert appear.

5. **[CLI] Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud datastream streams list --location=us-central1
# delete the stream in the console, then:
gcloud sql instances delete lab-mysql --quiet</span>

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Backfill | Existing rows copied first |
| CDC | Updates and inserts arrive within minutes |
| BigQuery dataset | `shop`, created by Datastream |
| Cost | Cloud SQL and Datastream are billed, so clean up |
